_README: Curated corrections to the heuristic per-screen data (scripts/screens-gather.mjs), merged by extras-assemble.mjs. Keyed by repo folder. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Per folder: 'drop' removes mis-detected screens by component/name; 'patch' edits a screen by component/name (name, path, roles, endpoints to replace, or addEndpoints to union); 'add' appends screens the parser missed. Use sparingly — prefer fixing the heuristic when a pattern is general.
